topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines the key learning objectives.

topics.label: Tumor viruses, oncogene discovery, and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the investigation of tumor-causing viruses led to the identification of cellular proto-oncogenes and the experimental assays used to measure cell transformation.

topics.label: Functional classes of cancer genes and mutation mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the major categories of cancer-associated genes and illustrate how oncogenic, tumor-suppressive, and dominant-negative mutations disrupt normal cellular regulation.

topics.label: Types, mechanisms, and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how failures in DNA repair pathways and errors during replication and mitosis generate sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Stepwise tumor progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the multi-step model of tumor development and how inherited mutations and genetic instability influence cancer progression.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding framing and recommended reading for the lecture.
